title: Approximate tangent spaces w.r.t. θ exist μ_V-a.e. (Simon 3.1.9)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open and V = v(M, θ) a rectifiable n-varifold in U with θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e. Then for μ_V-a.e. x there is a subspace P such that P is the approximate tangent space of M at x with respect to θ in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.7 (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P
